messages:
lydia: FYI CI failed on today's regen -> publish flow for the JS SDK/sample-app combo. It looks like a tiny typegen ordering change caused runtime breakage during the publish smoke.

kevin: can you paste the error snippet?

lydia: sure. gist: 
```
> node dist/index.js
TypeError: client.createRecord is not a function
 at Object.<anonymous> (dist/app.js:102)
 at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:776:30)
```

lydia: regendiff shows a parameter order swap in generated client overloads (args: body, opts -> opts, body). The typing changed but semver bot bumped minor automatically.

ravi: ugh. That ordering is non-breaking for the generator heuristics but breaks existing callsites in JS when overload resolution picks the wrong signature.

kevin: did release-bot already open a changelog PR?

release-bot: changelog PR #1502 created (level: minor) based on automated type/exports diff. To modify: `/release-bot adjust-level PR#1502 patch` or submit a manual changelog PR.

lydia: we should avoid forcing a minor if the change is just generator nondeterminism. Options: revert the regen, patch the generator to prefer stable ordering, or add a compatibility wrapper in the SDK.

maya: my vote is revert the regen in upstream and then fix the generator. Reverting is fastest and least painful for downstream users.

ravi: agreed. Also we should gate semver detection so it runs after the sample-app smoke publish has been tried against the generated package. That would have blocked this.

kevin: +1. Practically: add a CI step that when files under `generated/**` change, run sample-app publish-smoke job and fail the semver check until it passes. We can implement in the pipeline with a path filter.

lydia: also noticed unrelated flakes from the auth/retry tests in the same build. They masked the real failure a bit. Can we add a deterministic stub for retry scenarios so auth tests don't randomly fail?

ravi: I can add a harness that deterministically returns 429 twice then 200 for the client retry test. Mark the test as flaky-guarded so it won't block unrelated changes.

kevin: for immediate mitigation I'll manually adjust the changelog to patch and land a revert PR for the regen. We'll open a generator bug and a pipeline ticket for the pre-release smoke gate.

ci-bot: build 2171508888.3 started for sample-app (revert-regen).

ravi: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/319 (revert auto typegen).

ci-bot: build 2171508888.3 passed 44b smoke publish succeeded.

lydia: changelog adjusted to patch. I also added a line to the release checklist: "run sample-app smoke publish after any generated client changes".

kevin: follow-ups: (1) add CI smoke gate for generated client changes; (2) add deterministic auth/retry harness and flaky-guard; (3) file generator task to make overload ordering stable. I'll create the tickets.

maya: thanks all. closing once the release artifacts finish uploading.

release-bot: release artifacts for v1.8.5 (patch) created and uploaded.
